name: Bybit Liveness Weekly Summary
description: Weekly Monday 9am UTC pipeline that queries Bybit liveness data (LIVENESS_SELF pass rate by region) for the past 7 days and sends a formatted summary to Lark IM. Flags regions with pass rate below 90%.

nodes.description: Query last 7 days of Bybit LIVENESS_SELF pass rate by real_region from ODPS
Compute global stats, flag regions below 90% threshold, format Lark message with top-10 regions
Send weekly summary to Lark IM
